checked property: ELF64/PE64 bytes and plans are admitted exactly when they are bounded, non-overlapping, W^X, entry-executable, relocation- and import-valid
BAR sizing disables decode, restores each dword before the next probe, never touches a register outside the function window, and publishes one resource or none
RSDT/XSDT, MCFG and HPET are published only when exact, bounded, aligned and non-overlapping, and a rejected table publishes nothing
MADT publishes a dense, unique, bounded CPU set with the executing BSP at logical zero or nothing
an early-system lookup returns exactly the signed payload for a canonical table and no other bytes
